title: 大版本声明：18.6.0 已发布、主干已删除的界面文案统一写入发版说明（约 35 条）
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Part of #36890. Ruling: 7153171432 (maintainer 「B」: released i18n keys that no code reads any more are retired in the coming major and declared).

## What

- Measure every key that `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` shipped and that origin/main no longer has. Compare the tag `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` with main, in every locale and namespace, and flatten nested keys. About 35 Studio keys are known: #36501 and #36652 removed them under `Clause-②: no`. There may be others.
- Add one changeset to `@object-ui/i18n`. It declares the removal for the major release: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, plus a 「Removed translation keys」 list that names each key once. The text tells a deployment that overrides one of these keys that the override no longer applies.
- Change no code. Restore nothing.

## Done when

- The changeset lists every key that 18.6.0 shipped and main lacks.
- A short script or test reproduces the list, cited in the PR body.

## Notes

- Size S. Not governed.
- **Premise:** no non-major release of `@object-ui/i18n` ships before the major. If one is planned, stop and report.
